rohoshyo.title: ভৈরব ঠাকুরের কেস #1: টালিগঞ্জের শেষ মেট্রো ও পঁয়ত্রিশ বছরের পুরোনো প্রেতযান 🚇
rohoshyo.summary:
Part 1: Chapter 1: On a foggy Kartik Monday night, Bhairab Thakur and Paltu enter Tollygunge Metro Station at midnight upon an emergency call from Station Master Samar Sen. Investigating missing trackman Biren Mondal, they discover vintage CCTV footage from 1984 showing a non-AC phantom train on dead siding track 3. Descending onto the dark track bed under Adi Ganga canal, they encounter suspended water droplets, ancient coir shoring rope, Morse code SOS signals from behind concrete pillar 14-B, and a horizontal violet camphor flame. Suddenly a 1984 metro train emerges through a solid brick wall, bringing clay-faced ghosts and displaying missing trackman Biren's halogen flashlight beam inside coach 2.
Chapter 2: Bhairab Thakur, Paltu, and Station Master Samar Sen board the phantom 1984 metro train on siding track 3, locating missing trackman Biren Mondal frozen beside clay-faced ghosts of 1984 workers. Samar Sen breaks down upon recognizing worker Rambharosa's rusted brass identity tag, leading to the spectral entry of Engineer Subhashish Roy. Subhashish exposes Samar's crime of locking the emergency bulkhead gate to hide an illicit tunneling cave-in under Adi Ganga. As high-tide river mud floods the coach and moving it backward toward the flooded breach, Samar agrees to issue a public confession. Bhairab Thakur uses sacred silt and his guru's lantern to form a spiritual shield as the front windshield shatters, leaving their survival hanging on the turn of dawn.
Chapter 3: In this chapter, Bhairab Thakur, Paltu, and Station Master Samar Sen descend into the dark underground siding of Tollygunge Metro where a vintage 1984 ghost train appears. Confronted by engineer Subhashish Roy, Samar breaks down and confesses his crime of locking the bulkhead gate during the fatal 1984 tunneling disaster. As Adi Ganga floodwaters rush into the flooding coach, Bhairab invokes sacred mantras and raises his brass lantern to shield them against the spectral tide. Samar Sen agrees to confess his crimes to the authorities to give peace to the trapped souls.
rohoshyo.last_lines: পুরোনো কোচের লোহা চিরে ফুটফুটে কার্তিক অমাবস্যার অন্ধকারে গোঙাতে গোঙাতে ধেয়ে এল পঁইতাল্লিশ বছরের পুরানো পলি আর বুদ্বুদ ওঠা নোনা নোংরা আদি গঙ্গার জল; ট্রেনের জানালাগুলো বিকট শব্দে ভেঙে চুরমার হয়ে গেল। / ঠাকুরমশাই! কোচের মেঝে ছ্যাঁদা হয়ে নদী ঢুকে পড়ছে! আমার হাঁটু পর্যন্ত কাদা জমে গেছে! বীরেনদাকে আমরা কি বাঁচাতে পারব না? / ওঁ শ্রীং হ্রীং মহাকালের রক্ষাকবচ স্বাহা! শুভাশিস, তোমার ক্রোধ সত্য, কিন্তু এই নিরপরাধ বীরেন মন্ডলকে ছাড়ো! সমর সেন কাল সকালে রেল পুলিশের কাছে নিজের অপরাধ স্বীকার করে লিখিত স্বীকারোক্তি দেবে আর গঙ্গায় তোমায় তর্পণ করবে—নচেৎ আমার এই পঞ্চগব্যের প্রদীপ তোমার মুক্তি চিরতরে রুদ্ধ করবে!

characters.name: Bhairab Thakur
characters.look: a tall thin old Bengali tantrik of about seventy, long grey matted hair tied on top of his head, thick grey beard, sharp kind eyes lined with kohl, red tilak on forehead, deep red dhoti and a black shawl, rudraksha beads, carries an old brass lantern and a bamboo staff

characters.look: a chubby nervous young Bengali man of about twenty-two, round face, messy short black hair, big round glasses, yellow checked shirt and blue jeans, cloth sling bag, always holding a small torch

characters.name: Samar Sen
characters.look: A fifty-eight-year-old senior metro station master, grey thinning hair, wearing clean navy-blue metro uniform with silver buttons, nervous sweaty forehead.

characters.intro_en: Samar Sen - senior station master at Tollygunge Metro Station, hiding a dangerous secret on the eve of retirement.

characters.name: Subhashish Roy
characters.look: A twenty-four-year-old ghost of a civil engineer, wearing faded 1980s khaki work shirt, muddy trousers, yellow hardhat, hands covered in dried river clay.
characters.intro: শুভাশিস রায় - ১৯৮৪ সালের মেট্রো সুড়ঙ্গ দুর্ঘটনায় মৃত তরুণ সিভিল ইঞ্জিনিয়ার, যাঁর আত্মা আজও মাটির গভীরে পথ খোঁজে।
characters.intro_en: Subhashish Roy - a young civil engineer who died in the 1984 metro tunnel cave-in.

karna.fmt: Bapi tells his uncle Nilkantha's case, with real dialogue between the characters
karna.title: কর্ণপিশাচিনী #2: এবং নদিয়ার সেই গোপন সাধনা 🕯️
karna.summary:
Part 1: Chapter 1: Nilkantha Acharya and his nephew Bapi discuss the terrifying origins of the Karna Pishachini on a stormy Kartik night in Nadia. Nilkantha recalls his youthful sadhana by the Jalangi river and the terrifying tests he faced. The Pishachini's presence manifests in the present room with freezing air and mocking laughter. Bapi finds himself trapped as the wooden door locks mysteriously from the outside. The chapter ends on a chilling note as the ghostly shadow closes in on Bapi.
Chapter 2: As Bapi faces the terrifying presence of the Karna Pishachini, Nilkantha intervenes to calm the spirit, revealing more about their dangerous bond. A new client, Ramlochan, arrives with a chilling tale of a bleeding ancestral tree and a brother who has become a living statue. Nilkantha calls upon the Pishachini to uncover the truth, but her whispers hint at a dark family secret and a deadlier reality than Ramlochan admits.
Chapter 3: English: Nilkantha and Bapi arrive at the ominous Belpukur mansion with Ramlochan on a stormy Kartik night. Nilkantha summons the Karna Pishachini, whose cold whisper reveals that Ramlochan's brother is already dead and replaced by something horrific. As they investigate the dark stairs, a sharp laugh and strange footsteps raise the terror to its peak.
Chapter 4: In this climactic conclusion to the Belpukur case, Nilkantha and Bapi find themselves trapped in a house of shadows where a Shankchunni poses as their client. Nilkantha must strike a dangerous bargain with his bound spirit, the Karna Pishachini, to escape a death trap that threatens to consume them both.
Chapter 5: After the harrowing events at Belpukur, Nilkantha is physically broken, his hair now completely white. A fisherman named Haradhan arrives at midnight with a locked ancient chest that seems to be alive, begging for help. As Nilkantha calls upon the Pishachini, she reveals that the chest contains a 'stolen soul' and that Haradhan has brought a curse directly to their doorstep.
Chapter 6: In this intense final chapter of the part, the ancient chest brought by Haradhan begins to open, revealing a malevolent entity with pale, fish-scaled fingers. Nilkantha realizes it's a 'stolen soul' from a submerged temple in the Jalangi river, a dangerous sacrifice that has returned. As the room turns freezing and black smoke erupts, the Karna Pishachini manifests, mocking Nilkantha's fear. She demands Bapi as her servant in exchange for driving the entity back, placing Nilkantha in a horrific dilemma. The chapter ends with the lamp going out, Haradhan being attacked by the entity, and Nilkantha screaming for Bapi to run into the darkness.
karna.last_lines: বাপি... পালা! ও আজ কাউকেই ছাড়বে না! ও সবটাই আগে থেকে জানত! / অন্ধকারে একটা খিলখিল হাসি আর নূপুরের শব্দে ঘরটা ভরে উঠল। হরাধনের শেষ গোঙানিটা আমার কানে এসে ধাক্কা খেল।

characters.name: Nilkantha
characters.look: Nilkantha Acharya, a thin Bengali astrologer of about sixty, grey hair combed back, grey stubble, deep tired eyes with dark circles, a red-and-black thread and a copper ring on his left hand, a cream panjabi and white dhoti, a brown woollen shawl, small round brass-rimmed glasses

characters.name: Bapi
characters.look: Bapi, Nilkantha's nephew, a slim Bengali college student of about twenty, short messy black hair, light moustache, a checked half-sleeve shirt and grey trousers, a cloth bag, a torch in his hand

characters.name: Pishachini
characters.look: the Karna Pishachini, a fierce tantric yogini spirit: tall, dark-skinned, wild loose black hair down to her knees, burning red eyes, a red sindoor mark on the forehead, a black saree with a blood-red border, bone and rudraksha ornaments, silver anklets, long thin fingers; she stays in smoke and lamp-shadow, mostly only a dark shape at the left shoulder; her face is seen only for a moment

characters.name: Ramlochan
characters.look: Ramlochan, a middle-aged wealthy villager from Belpukur, stout build, a receding hairline, wearing a white kurta and a grey shawl, his hands tremble as he holds a wooden box
characters.intro: রামলোচনবাবু - বেলপুকুরের অবস্থাপন্ন গৃহস্থ, যাঁর চোখেমুখে এক অজানা আতঙ্কের ছাপ স্পষ্ট ফুটে উঠেছে।
characters.intro_en: Ramlochan Babu - a wealthy villager from Belpukur, with an obvious mark of unknown terror on his face.

characters.name: Haradhan
characters.look: An old man in his late sixties, skeletal frame, wearing a torn yellow dhoti and a thin plastic sheet as a raincoat, his eyes are bloodshot and wandering, hands shaking violently
characters.intro: হরাধন মণ্ডল - গ্রামের এক মৎস্যজীবী, যার চোখেমুখের আতঙ্ক দেখে মনে হচ্ছে সে সাক্ষাৎ যমদূতকে দেখে এসেছে।
characters.intro_en: Haradhan Mandal - a village fisherman whose face is twisted with such terror it seems he has seen the God of Death himself.
